headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty hit eight-month highs; markets closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada holiday

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: NSE and BSE are closed today for the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday
Strong performance in banking and pharmaceutical sectors drove gains in the last session
A correction in global oil prices improved investor sentiment in the previous session
RBI is reportedly querying bank valuations of certain bond derivative trades
whatHappening: Sensex closed above 81,000, gaining 107 points in the last trading session
Nifty settled above the 25,000 mark, reaching its highest level in over eight months
Data Patterns shares surged 9% during Monday's market activity
Market operations are scheduled to resume on Wednesday, 11 November
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada, with trading resuming on Wednesday. In the last session, the Sensex and Nifty reached eight-month highs, closing above 81,000 and 25,000 respectively. Gains were driven by banking and pharma stocks, while Data Patterns shares surged 9%.
